review: 702.174e-1: expected outcomes said only Grizzly Bears gains hexproof and indestructible, but Dawn's Truce affects every permanent A controls; rewrote both expected outcomes to include the Plains.

702.174g-1: both libraries were empty while play continued through B's turns, so B would lose drawing from an empty library (704.5b) before the extra turn could be observed; gave A two Plains and B three Islands in library and added Island to cards.

scenarios.title: Promising a gift is a no-mana additional cost, and a promised Food gift is created before the spell's other effects
decisions: A casts Crumb and Get It targeting Grizzly Bears, choosing B as the opponent to promise the gift to, and pays {W} by tapping Plains.
Both players pass; Crumb and Get It resolves.

variants.label: promised
variants.expected: The gift was promised. B creates a Food token first. Grizzly Bears gets +2/+2 (4/4) and indestructible until end of turn. Crumb and Get It moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: not_promised
variants.delta: A does not choose an opponent, so the gift is not promised.
variants.expected: B creates no Food token. Grizzly Bears gets +2/+2 (4/4) until end of turn and does not gain indestructible. Crumb and Get It moves to A's graveyard.

scenarios.title: A gift permanent's enters trigger and gift effect happen only if the gift was promised
decisions: A casts Scrapshooter, choosing B as the opponent to promise the gift to, and pays {1}{G}{G} by tapping three Forests.
B passes with Counterspell unused; Scrapshooter resolves and enters the battlefield.
Scrapshooter's enters trigger targets Sol Ring and the gift trigger is put on the stack; A orders the destroy trigger first. Both resolve.

variants.label: promised
variants.expected: Scrapshooter's enters trigger fires and destroys Sol Ring (moves to B's graveyard). B draws a card from the gift (hand: Counterspell and Mountain).

variants.label: not_promised
variants.delta: A does not choose an opponent, so the gift is not promised.
variants.expected: Neither trigger fires. Sol Ring stays on B's battlefield and B's hand stays Counterspell only.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: A promises the gift, but B casts Counterspell on Scrapshooter, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Scrapshooter is countered and moves to A's graveyard. It never enters, so neither trigger fires, B draws no card and Sol Ring stays on the battlefield. B's hand is empty because Counterspell was cast.

scenarios.title: A give-a-gift trigger fires when a gifted spell resolves
decisions: A casts Crumb and Get It targeting Grizzly Bears, choosing B as the opponent to promise the gift to, and pays {W} by tapping a Plains.
B passes with Counterspell unused; Crumb and Get It resolves and Jolly Gerbils' trigger, if it fired, resolves.

variants.label: promised
variants.expected: Crumb and Get It resolves with its gift: B creates a Food token. Jolly Gerbils' trigger fires and A draws a card (hand: Forest).

variants.label: not_promised
variants.delta: A does not choose an opponent, so the gift is not promised.
variants.expected: Crumb and Get It resolves without a gift. Jolly Gerbils' trigger does not fire and A draws no card.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: A promises the gift, but B casts Counterspell on Crumb and Get It, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Crumb and Get It is countered, so no gift is given: B creates no Food token, Jolly Gerbils' trigger does not fire and A draws no card.

scenarios.title: A give-a-gift trigger also fires when a gift triggered ability resolves
decisions: A casts Scrapshooter, choosing B as the opponent to promise the gift to, and pays {1}{G}{G} by tapping three Forests.
Both players pass; Scrapshooter resolves and enters. Its enters triggers (destroy Sol Ring; gift draw) and Jolly Gerbils' trigger, if it fires, are put on the stack and resolve.

variants.label: promised
variants.expected: The gift triggered ability resolves: B draws a card. Jolly Gerbils' trigger fires and A draws a card (hand: Plains). Sol Ring is destroyed.

variants.label: not_promised
variants.delta: A does not choose an opponent, so the gift is not promised.
variants.expected: No gift triggered ability resolves. Jolly Gerbils' trigger does not fire and A draws no card. Sol Ring stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements the permanent's gift as a GiftAbility SVar that may not raise the GiveGift trigger; this scenario tests whether it does.

scenarios.title: Gift a card makes the chosen opponent draw a card
decisions: A casts Dawn's Truce, choosing B as the opponent to promise the gift to, and pays {1}{W} by tapping both Plains.
Both players pass; Dawn's Truce resolves.

variants.label: promised
variants.expected: B draws the top card of their library (hand: Mountain), before the other effects. A and each permanent A controls (both Plains and Grizzly Bears) gain hexproof, and each permanent A controls also gains indestructible until end of turn.

variants.label: not_promised
variants.delta: A does not choose an opponent, so the gift is not promised.
variants.expected: B draws no card (hand empty). A and each permanent A controls (both Plains and Grizzly Bears) gain hexproof until end of turn; no permanent gains indestructible.

scenarios.title: Gift a tapped Fish makes the chosen opponent create a tapped 1/1 blue Fish
decisions: A casts Parting Gust targeting Grizzly Bears, choosing B as the opponent to promise the gift to, and pays {W}{W} by tapping both Plains.
Both players pass; Parting Gust resolves. The turn then advances to its end step.

variants.label: promised
variants.expected: B creates a tapped 1/1 blue Fish creature token. Grizzly Bears is exiled and stays exiled; it does not return at the end step.

variants.label: not_promised
variants.delta: A does not choose an opponent, so the gift is not promised.
variants.expected: B creates no Fish. Grizzly Bears is exiled, then returns to the battlefield under B's control at the beginning of the next end step with a +1/+1 counter (3/3).

scenarios.title: Gift an extra turn gives the chosen opponent an extra turn after this one
decisions: A casts Perch Protection, choosing B as the opponent to promise the gift to, and pays {4}{W}{W} by tapping six Plains.
Both players pass; Perch Protection resolves. Play continues through the end of A's turn and the following turns with no further actions.

variants.label: promised
variants.expected: B is given an extra turn. After A's turn ends, B takes a turn and then a second, consecutive turn, and A's next turn is the third turn after this one. A created four 2/2 blue Bird tokens with flying, which (with A's other permanents) phased out, and Perch Protection is exiled.

variants.label: not_promised
variants.delta: A does not choose an opponent, so the gift is not promised.
variants.expected: B receives no extra turn. After A's turn ends, B takes one turn and then A takes the next. A created four 2/2 blue Bird tokens with flying, which stay on the battlefield phased in, and Perch Protection is exiled.

scenarios.forge_notes: Both variants also exile Perch Protection and create the four Birds. The promised-gift phasing and protection effects are not what this scenario checks.

scenarios.title: Gift a Treasure makes the chosen opponent create a Treasure token
decisions: A casts Blooming Blast targeting Grizzly Bears, choosing B as the opponent to promise the gift to, and pays {1}{R} by tapping both Mountains.
Both players pass; Blooming Blast resolves.

variants.label: promised
variants.expected: B creates a Treasure token first. Blooming Blast deals 2 damage to Grizzly Bears, which moves to B's graveyard, and 3 damage to B (life 17).

variants.label: not_promised
variants.delta: A does not choose an opponent, so the gift is not promised.
variants.expected: B creates no Treasure. Grizzly Bears takes 2 damage and moves to B's graveyard. B's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: Gift an Octopus makes the chosen opponent create an 8/8 blue Octopus when the gift permanent enters
decisions: A casts Octomancer, choosing B as the opponent to promise the gift to, and pays {3}{G}{U} by tapping all five lands.
Both players pass; Octomancer resolves and enters, and its gift trigger resolves.

variants.label: promised
variants.expected: Octomancer's gift trigger fires on entering and B creates an 8/8 blue Octopus creature token. Octomancer (3/3) is on A's battlefield.

variants.label: not_promised
variants.delta: A does not choose an opponent, so the gift is not promised.
variants.expected: No gift trigger fires and B has no Octopus. Octomancer (3/3) is on A's battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Observe immediately after the gift trigger resolves: at the beginning of the end step Octomancer's own trigger copies an Octopus token that entered this turn.

scenarios.title: A gifted spell that is countered or fizzles gives no gift
decisions: A casts Parting Gust targeting Grizzly Bears, choosing B as the opponent to promise the gift to, and pays {W}{W} by tapping both Plains.
B and A pass without responding; Parting Gust resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: B creates a tapped 1/1 blue Fish creature token and Grizzly Bears is exiled.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B casts Counterspell on Parting Gust, tapping both Islands, before it resolves.
variants.expected: Parting Gust is countered and moves to A's graveyard. B creates no Fish and Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: fizzles
variants.delta: A responds by casting Shock on Grizzly Bears, tapping the Mountain, before Parting Gust resolves.
variants.expected: Shock resolves first and Grizzly Bears moves to B's graveyard. Parting Gust fizzles with no legal target and moves to A's graveyard. B creates no Fish.

scenarios.forge_notes: A fizzled spell never resolves, so Forge must skip the GiftAbility sub-effect; verify.

scenarios.title: A gift-conditional target is chosen only if the gift was promised
decisions: A casts Mind Spiral targeting A, choosing B as the opponent to promise the gift to and targeting Grizzly Bears with the gift-conditional tap, and pays {4}{U} by tapping all five Islands.
Both players pass; Mind Spiral resolves.

variants.label: promised
variants.expected: B creates a tapped 1/1 blue Fish first. A draws three cards (hand: three Plains). Grizzly Bears is tapped and gets a stun counter.

variants.label: not_promised
variants.delta: A does not choose an opponent, so the gift is not promised and no second target is chosen.
variants.expected: B creates no Fish. A draws three cards. Grizzly Bears stays untapped with no counters; Mind Spiral had only one target.
